title: GTA6 Tribunal: Final Hearing Begins in Rockstar Fired Devs Case
description: The final hearing in the Rockstar Games versus 31 fired GTA6 developers tribunal has begun in Scotland with rallies. Read the full report on GTA6 Hub.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Developer Dispute Reaches Critical Junction: Final Tribunal Hearing Begins

The ongoing employment dispute surrounding Rockstar Games and the 31 fired developers of *GTA6* has officially reached its final chapter. According to reports from media outlet Eurogamer, the final hearing in the employment tribunal has commenced in Scotland, drawing significant attention from the gaming community and industry observers alike.

The controversy dates back to last October, when the 31 developers were unceremoniously marched out of the company's offices. The abrupt dismissal sent shockwaves through the industry, raising questions about workplace practices behind the development of one of the most anticipated video games in history.

## Rallies and Rousing Speeches: Fighting Fear in Scotland

The opening of the final hearing was marked by emotional and determined demonstrations outside. Former employees, abruptly shown the door months prior, gathered for rallies featuring rousing speeches. Setting the tone for the proceedings, participants declared, "Today, we are fighting fear." These powerful words underscored the personal and professional stakes involved for the workers taking a stand against a major industry titan.

While fans eagerly await any news regarding *GTA6*, the human element behind the development process remains a crucial part of the story. The outcome of this tribunal could set a powerful precedent for labor rights and developer treatment within the AAA gaming sector.

## Editor's Take

Behind every blockbuster game like *GTA6* are the developers who build it. This tribunal highlights the critical need for fair treatment and worker protection in the gaming industry. We will continue to monitor how this legal battle concludes and what it means for the people behind our favorite games.
